# gsm_project_observability_sink (Resource)

Manages a project observability sink. Exactly one of `log`, `metric`, `trace`, `node_metric` and `datadog_agent` sets the sink type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_project_secret" "datadog" {
  project_id  = "<project_id>"
  secret_name = "datadog"

  kv = {
    api-key         = "<datadog_api_key>"
    application-key = "<datadog_application_key>"
  }
}

# Container logs sent to Datadog, parsed as JSON
resource "gsm_project_observability_sink" "logs" {
  project_id              = "<project_id>"
  observability_sink_name = "game-logs"

  log {
    datadog {
      api_key         = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.datadog.secret_name}:api-key"
      application_key = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.datadog.secret_name}:application-key"
      site            = "datadoghq.com"
    }

    parser_type = "json"
    k8s_label_mapping = {
      app = "service"
    }
  }
}

# Game server metrics sent to Datadog
resource "gsm_project_observability_sink" "metrics" {
  project_id              = "<project_id>"
  observability_sink_name = "game-metrics"

  metric {
    datadog {
      api_key         = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.datadog.secret_name}:api-key"
      application_key = "!ref:secret:${gsm_project_secret.datadog.secret_name}:application-key"
    }

    pod_labels_as_tags = {
      app = "service"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `observability_sink_name` (String) Name of the observability sink. Squadron templates reference the sink by this name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the observability sink belongs

### Optional

- `datadog_agent` (Block List, Max: 1) Runs a Datadog agent for the game servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--datadog_agent))
- `description` (String) Description of the observability sink
- `log` (Block List, Max: 1) Sends container logs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--log))
- `metric` (Block List, Max: 1) Sends game server metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--metric))
- `node_metric` (Block List, Max: 1) Sends node metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--node_metric))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `trace` (Block List, Max: 1) Sends traces (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--trace))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--datadog_agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datadog_agent`

Required:

- `datadog` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Datadog backends that receive the data. Credentials should be secret references (`!ref:secret:<name>:<key>`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--datadog_agent--datadog))

Optional:

- `add_tags` (Map of String) Static tags to add
- `drop_metrics` (List of String) Metrics to drop
- `node_labels_as_tags` (Map of String) Node labels to add as tags, keyed by label with the tag name as value
- `pod_annotations_as_tags` (Map of String) Pod annotations to add as tags, keyed by annotation with the tag name as value
- `pod_labels_as_tags` (Map of String) Pod labels to add as tags, keyed by label with the tag name as value
- `remove_tags` (List of String) Tags to remove
- `rename_metrics` (Map of String) Metrics to rename, keyed by the current name
- `rename_tags` (Map of String) Tags to rename, keyed by the current name

- `site` (String) Datadog site, e.g. `datadoghq.com`
